county.name: Paul Simba Arati
county.note: Confirmed by two sources: the Kisii County Government site reports him sworn in as Governor (kisii.go.ke, "H.E Hon. Paul Simba Arati Sworn In as Governor"), and Capital FM reports his swearing-in. Declared with 270,928 votes (Mzalendo; Gazette 9949 was not found in search and is not relied on). No removal found as of the search date.

county.name: Elijah Obebo
county.since: Jul 2024 (sworn in after a High Court order)
county.note: Robert Monda, elected Deputy Governor with Governor Arati in 2022, was impeached by the County Assembly; the Senate upheld the impeachment in March 2024. The Governor nominated Elijah Obebo, then chair of the County Public Service Board, and the Assembly approved him. On 4 July 2024 the High Court at Kisii directed the IEBC to gazette him or have him sworn in; he was sworn in at Gusii Stadium in July 2024. Monda went to court against his removal; conservatory orders were refused in 2024 and no final outcome was found as of Nov 2026.

county.name: Philip Nyanumba
county.since: Elected after the 2022 election (date not confirmed); presiding Mar 2026
county.note: Elected the Assembly's third Speaker with 47 votes to 21, replacing David Kombo (Mount Kenya Times, undated). The county website's Speaker page still names an earlier Speaker.

mcaSourceName: IEBC Gazette Notice No. 9956 (2022 baseline; no later changes found)
mcaGazetteNote: Built 28 Nov 2026. All 45 MCAs from IEBC Gazette Notice No. 9956 (Vol. CXXIV, No. 170, 24 Aug 2022), file sha256 eafe12d9…23e2a; every name, party and vote count was matched by script to its ward line in the PDF text. All 45 names confirmed against the Kisii County Assembly member list (kisiiassembly.go.ke, updated 27 Nov 2026). Gazette name order differs on 10 wards (Kiamokama, Monyerero, Sensi, Marani, Kegogi, Bogusero, Bogeka, Nyakoe, Kitutu Central, Nyatieko); the County Assembly listing is used as the current record. Kiogoro confirmed earlier against gazette 9956 and Mzalendo. The IEBC by-election gazette of 1 Dec 2025 lists no Kisii ward, and searches did not find any Kisii MCA death, nullification or by-election since Aug 2022 (not exhaustive). Party names are those printed in 2022; members may have changed party since. mcaGazetteChecked stays false pending Rigoma/Bokeira resolution (Nyamira wards) and character-by-character gazette PDF check.

kiamokama.name: Malack Mainya Matara
kiamokama.note: Confirmed against the Kisii County Assembly member list (kisiiassembly.go.ke, updated 27 Nov 2026): Malack Mainya Matara (ODM). Gazette 9956 gives surname Malack, other names Mainya Matara (2,886 votes) - name order differs; the County Assembly listing is used as the current record. The seat fell vacant on the death of the 2022 MCA and a by-election was held; reports name the winner as Malachi Matara (ODM), consistent with this record.
